title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — No More Franks And Beans
A first time inmate says he must turn to violence to avoid becoming a victim, an accused rapist gets into more trouble in jail and what he does next has some questioning his motives.

title: Lockup: Charleston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Suicide Watch
An agitated inmate takes severe measures to get staff's attention; a young first-timer is found unconscious in his cell; another inmate garners "enemy status" within the jail.

title: Lockup: Orange County: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — The Confession
Inside the Orange County Jail a senior inmate takes up rap; a gang member poses a threat; another inmate makes the most shocking confession ever heard on Lockup.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E11 — The Car Con
Brothers Darain and Cory Atkinson start a business selling vehicle service contracts, but the warranties prove worthless and the brothers pocket millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E5 — The Cash King
A man sets his sights on strip clubs, real estate, Iraqi currency, diamonds and even mind control technology.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E12 — The Spy Who Conned Me
A former weatherman claiming to be an undercover spy infiltrates Washington's intelligence circles where he collects millions with his tales of running a top-secret national security operation for the CIA.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Miss Fortune
A troubled young inmate, recently sentenced to prison, attempts to make a final impression on staff; a young woman who gave birth in the jail watches her baby grow up without her.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Next of Kin
The jail responds with force after an officer is assaulted and inmates attempt escape; an 18-year-old shoots her father to death then finds a surrogate mother on the inside.

description:
S2 E11 — Tennessee Women's Prison
Inmates at Tennessee Prison For Women gain career skills by taking part in a cosmetology program.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Close Quarters
The vast majority of inmates live in two-man cells but even with careful screening, conflicts can still arise between cellmates; one inmate covers up his own beating, and plucked from death row, another inmate tries to make a difference.
